_readme: 6 index underlyings -- the single source of truth for indices across this app (Scanner, GapFill curated list, symbol search). Plain shape only: name/symbol/exchange/type. F&O-specific fields (expiryTypes, expiryDayRule, etc.) live separately in derivatives-config.json, keyed by 'name', so this file stays lean and usable by any consumer regardless of whether it cares about derivatives tracking. FINNIFTY's spot symbol was changed from NSE:CNXFINANCE-INDEX to NSE:FINNIFTY-INDEX on 2026-08-06 -- live-confirmed via Fyers Symbol Search (working option chain, futures, and index quote all returned under FINNIFTY-INDEX; CNXFINANCE returned an unrelated stock, CSL Finance Limited, not this index). BANKEX added 2026-08-06 as a 6th index -- live-confirmed real, tradable BSE index with working futures/options via Fyers Symbol Search. See derivatives-config.json for BANKEX's F&O config -- its expiry day rule is NOT yet confirmed, do not assume a value from this file alone.
